name: atem-crosspoint
description: Crosspoint router matrix for a fleet of Blackmagic ATEM switchers, with Videohub protocol emulation

scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace @av/videohub && npm run build --workspace @av/atem-matrix
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && npm run dev --workspace @atem-crosspoint/server
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build:libs && npm run dev:mock --workspace @atem-crosspoint/server
scripts.dev:replay: npm run build:libs && npm run dev --workspace @atem-crosspoint/server
scripts.sim: npm run build:libs && npm run dev:sim --workspace @atem-crosspoint/web
scripts.sim:build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:sim --workspace @atem-crosspoint/web
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace @atem-crosspoint/web && npm run build --workspace @atem-crosspoint/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspace @atem-crosspoint/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @atem-crosspoint/web
scripts.capture: npm run build:libs && npm run capture --workspace @atem-crosspoint/server --
